hypothesis: For BF16 D=8192 multi-row blocks, keeping the once-loaded gamma/bias parameters in their native BF16 representation reduces UB use while preserving per-block GM parameter reuse. Widening only the consumed tile avoids using input staging buffers as parameter storage, the source of the R005 overwrite failure.
change: Allocate the D=8192 full-row parameter caches in native T and cast each gamma/bias tile into the existing FP32 work buffers during output. Non-full-row shapes retain the existing FP32 cache allocation and path.
